trends.what: A curated list of free public APIs for developers to use in their projects.
trends.why: It's a one-stop reference for developers looking to quickly integrate third-party data or services without building from scratch.

trends.what: An open-source platform offering free coding lessons, projects, and certifications in math, programming, and computer science.
trends.why: It's a massive, community-driven educational resource that keeps growing, making it a go-to for self-taught developers.

trends.what: A comprehensive collection of freely available programming books and learning materials in multiple languages.
trends.why: It's the ultimate free resource hub for learners, saving people money while providing high-quality technical knowledge.

trends.what: A personal AI assistant that runs on any OS and platform, designed to be your always-available digital helper.
trends.why: It's trending because it promises a cross-platform, open-source alternative to proprietary AI assistants, appealing to privacy-conscious users.

trends.what: Interactive roadmaps, guides, and educational content to help developers plan their career growth and skill acquisition.
trends.why: It's trending because it gives developers a clear, visual path through the overwhelming landscape of tech skills and roles.

trends.what: A tool that makes AI agents write code like a lazy senior developer, prioritizing minimal, efficient solutions.
trends.why: It's trending because it humorously and practically addresses the common problem of AI generating over-engineered code.

trends.what: A fullscreen, mouse-interactive coding agent harness and TUI from SpaceXAI, designed for building and testing code.
trends.why: It's trending because it offers a novel, interactive terminal experience for AI-assisted coding, pushing the boundaries of developer tooling.

trends.what: A pure C, zero-dependency runtime that runs frontier mixture-of-experts AI models on existing hardware by streaming experts from disk.
trends.why: It's trending because it democratizes access to large AI models, letting people run them on modest machines without expensive GPUs.
